4098c5dbb6ac47ff.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the account.

2e280676240e76ca.column_purpose: Date the account was opened (range 1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29).

5847311f7cbbccbb.column_purpose: Foreign key to district.district_id; the district (region) of the bank branch where the account was opened.

d279ffd01b540593.column_purpose: Frequency of fee/statement issuance, in Czech: POPLATEK MESICNE = monthly, POPLATEK TYDNE = weekly, POPLATEK PO OBRATU = after each transaction.

e890e252f9953ba5.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the issued card.

5d91224dcba0eb45.column_purpose: Foreign key to disp.disp_id, identifying the disposition (person-account relationship) of the card holder; one-to-one, so each disposition has at most one card.

49e3bb7efc98c737.column_purpose: Date the card was issued (stored as text, format YYYY-MM-DD).

2127703734257a4a.column_purpose: Card product tier: 'classic' (standard card, 659), 'junior' (youth card, 145), 'gold' (premium card, 88).

60e8c380430907ed.column_purpose: Client's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Range 1911-1987 is consistent with birth dates of living clients.

1d1ddbd0bec85974.column_purpose: Primary key; unique client identifier. Referenced one-to-one by disp.client_id (each client has one disposition/account link in this data).

70e9a2cc47e375b4.column_purpose: Foreign key to district.district_id; the client's district (region) of residence, 1-77 Czech districts.

442fd29f43527c9e.column_purpose: Identifier of the bank account this disposition refers to; references account.account_id (many dispositions per account).

f159a6825161df6b.column_purpose: Identifier of the client attached to the account; references client.client_id. Unique in this table (each client appears in exactly one disposition).

ec16d8d0ffb3db89.column_purpose: Primary key of the disposition record; also referenced by card.disp_id, i.e. a payment card is issued through a disposition.

c45d71f47d7397d0.column_purpose: Type of client relationship to the account: OWNER (account holder, 4500 rows, one per account) or DISPONENT (authorized user / disponent, 869 rows).

55767416c1287984.column_purpose: Average monthly salary in the district (CZK; values ~8,100-12,500).

08fb2fc785a213cf.column_purpose: Number of registered entrepreneurs per 1,000 inhabitants (values 81-167).

0c9840ec2567a32e.column_purpose: Number of committed crimes in 1995 (counts; Prague outlier ~85,677).

d0098d7b819f5f93.column_purpose: Number of committed crimes in 1996 (counts; Prague outlier ~99,107).

c422aab428b82b18.column_purpose: Name of the district (e.g. Benesov, Brno - mesto, Jablonec n. Nisou).

fbb70fe7e4994a35.column_purpose: Region of the Czech Republic the district belongs to (8 values: Prague, central/north/south/east Bohemia, north/south Moravia).

58f9dbd7f31da099.column_purpose: Total number of inhabitants of the district (stored as text; Prague ~1.2M).

6e7ce2022863cadc.column_purpose: Number of municipalities with fewer than 500 inhabitants (stored as text).

89a4b91a6941db67.column_purpose: Number of municipalities with 500-1,999 inhabitants (stored as text).

a119bc6b326adf2e.column_purpose: Number of municipalities with 2,000-9,999 inhabitants (stored as text).

f3d246029c2a1b67.column_purpose: Number of municipalities with 10,000 or more inhabitants (stored as text).

96169e30683e1cab.column_purpose: Number of cities in the district (1-11).

16e5f7d746c891e4.column_purpose: Primary key; district identifier 1-77. Referenced by client.district_id and account.district_id.

5e6d21b3e86c7379.column_purpose: Identifier of the account that took out the loan; references account.account_id (one-to-one here, i.e. at most one loan per account in this table).

a442248131245b3a.column_purpose: Principal amount of the loan, in the account currency (values 4,980 to 590,820, median ~116,928).

f5b77244decaa8ac.column_purpose: Date the loan was granted (1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08).

e5b9857a12fe2b81.column_purpose: Loan term in months; only values 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 occur.

30ed9bd876384fe5.column_purpose: Monthly installment payment for the loan (304 to 9,910). Consistent with amount/duration, e.g. 76080/12 = 6340.

42e2bd72e3077d26.column_purpose: Loan repayment status code with four values A, B, C, D. Most plausible reading (standard for this schema): A = contract finished, loan paid; B = contract finished, loan not paid; C = contract running, payments OK; D = contract running, client in debt. Exact mapping is not provable from the data alone.

e880654ca842824a.column_purpose: Owning account; references account.account_id (many orders per account).

9174072eceb8dcda.column_purpose: Destination account number at the external bank receiving the payment.

27fc51b582ccec05.column_purpose: Payment amount per occurrence, in the account currency (values 1–14882, median ~2596).

707aabe7b2348d3f.column_purpose: Code of the destination bank (13 anonymized two-letter codes).

441773b958db8743.column_purpose: Payment type/character: SIPO (household/utility payment), UVER (loan repayment), POJISTNE (insurance premium), LEASING (leasing payment), empty = unspecified/other.

5cf138eef7cc1bc7.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the standing order.

e1979aefed2724f2.column_purpose: Account number of the counterparty for bank transfers (operation PREVOD NA UCET / PREVOD Z UCTU). Null (72%) for cash withdrawals/deposits. Values are large opaque account numbers; '0' (21881 rows) likely means no/unknown counterparty account. Not a join key to the account table in this database.

a0d412b27e7d6ef9.column_purpose: ID of the account the transaction belongs to; references account.account_id (many transactions per account).

41087edc5366c609.column_purpose: Transaction amount in the account's currency (Czech crowns, whole units). Min 0, max 87,400; median 2,100. The very frequent value 15 likely a recurring small fee/payment.

21615ee2e43e9858.column_purpose: Account balance in crowns after the transaction. Can be negative (overdraft, min -41,126), max 209,637.

e24436792e7aa9f6.column_purpose: Two-letter code of the counterparty bank for transfers (PREVOD operations); null for cash operations. 13 anonymized bank codes (QR, AB, ST, ...).

6fdf51eb1bf1fdda.column_purpose: Czech code describing the transaction's purpose: UROK = interest credited, SLUZBY = payment for services/statement, SIPO = household (utility) payment, DUCHOD = old-age pension, UVER = loan payment, POJISTNE = insurance payment, SANKC. UROK = sanction interest. Blank/null when not applicable.

9dfa013f8dec77f9.column_purpose: Czech operation mode: VYBER = cash withdrawal, VYBER KARTOU = card withdrawal, VKLAD = cash deposit, PREVOD NA UCET = transfer to another account, PREVOD Z UCTU = transfer from another account. Null (17%) likely for interest credit rows.

4bfd10fb422991c0.column_purpose: Czech transaction type: PRIJEM = credit (income), VYDAJ = debit (expense), VYBER = withdrawal (recorded separately from VYDAJ).
